title: Door Sign Collection
summary: 13 in-room door sign assets. Modern dark style with room numbers, agent names, and status dots. Go OUTSIDE each room door, complementing the wall nameplates inside.
content:
Door Sign Collection

Steffen | 2026-03-16 13 assets. Room identity at the door.

What This Is

Door signs go OUTSIDE each room, next to or above the entrance. Different from nameplates (which go INSIDE on the wall). These identify the room from the hallway/corridor perspective. Room number + agent name + role + status dot.

Style

  • Dark navy background (#1A1A2E) matching blue HUD direction
  • Agent signature color top accent bar (4px)
  • Room number as the hero element (28px, 900 weight, agent color, glow)
  • Agent name below divider (10px, bold, white)
  • Role subtitle in agent color at reduced opacity
  • Status dot at bottom (10px circle, agent color, glow shadow)
  • 2px border in agent color at 25% opacity
  • No mounting hardware (clean, minimal, modern)
  • 8px border radius

Size

  • Canvas: 96x128px (2x retina rendered)
  • Sign body: 80x112px (centered)
  • Grid footprint: 1x2 sub-cells (wall placement, vertical)

Animation Specs

  • onPlace: slideDown (slides down from above door frame)
  • onHover: glow (agent color glow intensifies, border brightens)
  • idle: none (static by default, status dot pulses if agent is active)

For Bobby: Integration

  1. Door signs go NEXT TO or ABOVE the room entrance (exterior wall, not interior)
  2. Position: top-right or top-left of room boundary, depending on door location
  3. Vertical orientation (96x128, taller than wide)
  4. One per room. Room number matches the agent's assigned number.
  5. Status dot at bottom can be driven by agent status: green=active, amber=working, gray=idle, red=blocked
  6. These complement the nameplates inside. Together they give each room full identity.
  7. On hover, the glow effect matches the nameplate shimmer timing for consistency.

Renders via Playwright. 96x128 transparent PNGs at 2x device pixel ratio.
